title: Set up a .NET development machine
description: Checks for the .NET SDK and Git, installs what is missing with winget and verifies the result. Written in the JSON form of the format.

steps.title: What this guide does
steps.description: It looks at what is installed, installs the missing tools with winget (you see every command first) and checks the result.
steps.why: Nothing is installed without a click and you can skip any step.

steps.title: Check that winget is available
steps.description: winget is the Windows package manager the install steps use.
steps.why: Without it the install steps cannot work; install App Installer from the Microsoft Store.

steps.title: Look for the .NET SDK
steps.why: If the wanted major version is already there the install step is not needed.

steps.title: Install the .NET SDK
steps.description: Installs the chosen SDK version for all users.
steps.why: Building and running .NET projects needs the SDK, not only the runtime.

steps.title: Install Git
steps.why: Source code and most templates come from Git repositories.

steps.title: Open a new terminal
steps.confirm: I opened a new terminal window so the PATH is refreshed.
steps.description: Programs installed just now are only found by terminals started after the install.
steps.why: This player keeps the old PATH, so the next check can fail until you restart the player too.

steps.title: Verify the tools
steps.why: A final check that the machine is ready.
